senses.gloss:
(इ) शडि r. 1st cl. (शंडते)
1 To disease or disorder.
2 To hurt or wound.
3 To collect, to heap together.

(ऋ) शाडृ r. 1st cl. (शाडते)
1 To flatter, to praise, to coax.
2 To boast.
3 To float or swim.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Abounding in fresh grass, green, verdant.
E.
शाद young grass, ड्वलच् aff., and the final changed, also शाड्वल.

m. (-णः)
A fish.
E.
षष् six, and अक्षि the eye, ख aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
1 Having six limbs or members.
2 Having six parts, six ingredients, &c.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Six parts of the body collectively; as the two arms, two legs, and the head, and waist.
2 The six supplementary parts of the Vedas, or grammar, prosody, astronomy, pronunciation, the meaning of unusual terms, and the ritual of the Hindu religion.
E.
षष् six, and अङ्ग a limb or part.

m. (-जित्)
VIṢṆU.
E.
षडङ्ग the six members, and जित् who subdues.

n. (-यं)
A infusion or decoction of six drugs.
E.
षडङ्ग, and पानीय drink.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
A bee.
E.
षष् six, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.

m. (-ज्ञ)
A Buddha or Bauddha deified sage.
E.
षष् six, (branches of learning or piety,) and अभिज्ञ understanding.

m. (-नः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
षष् six, and आनन a face; having six faces, four directed to the four cardinal points, and two to the zenith and nadir, according to some accounts, though not generally so represented.

n. (-णं)
Six spices collectively, or long-pepper, black-pepper, dried ginger, the root of long-pepper, the fruit of the plumbago, and of the Piper chavya.
E.
षष् six, and ऊषण a spice.

m. plur. (-तवः)
The six seasons; also personified as divinities.
E.
षष्, and ऋतु a season.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Six-fold, six times.
n. (-णं)
An assemblage of six qualities or properties.
mf. (-णः-णा)
The six acts of a king, in his military character, or peace, war, marching, halting, sowing dissension, seeking protection.
E.
षष्, and गुण a time.

m. (-न्थः)
A variety of the Cæsalpinia bonducella.
f. (-न्था)
Orris root, (Acorus calamus.)
E.
षष् six, ग्रन्थि a knot.

f. (-का)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)
E.
षड्ग्रन्थ as above, and कन् added.

m. (-ड्जः)
The fourth note of the Hindu gamut.
E.
षष् six, and ज born: supposed to require for its articulation the employment of the tongue, teeth, palate, nose, throat, and chest.

ind.
In six ways.
E.
षष् six, and धाच् aff.

m. (-गः)
A sixth, a sixth part.
E.
षष्, and भाग share.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Entitled to a sixth.
E.
षड्भाग, and भाज् who shares.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Six-armed, six-sided.
m. (-जः)
A hexagon.
f. (-जा)
The water-melon.
E.
षष् six, भुज an arm or branch, &c., aff. टाप्.

f. (-खा)
A water-melon.
E.
षष् six, and रेखा a line.

m. (-र्गः)
A class or aggregate of six, as of six defects, desire, wrath, covetousness, bewilderment, pride, and envy.
E.
षष् six, and वर्ग a class.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Subject to the six vices.
E.
षड्वर्ग, and वश्य to be subjected.

mfn. (-घः-घा-धं)
In six ways, of six kinds.
E.
षष्, and विध kind.

m. (-न्दुः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
षष् six, and विन्दु a drop or spot.

m. (-वः)
1 Sentiment, passion.
2 Singing, music.

n. (-ण्यं)
1 An aggregate of six properties or qualities.
2 The six acts of royal military policy.
3 Increase or multiplication, six-fold.
E.
षङ्गुण, and यञ् aff.
